subject: Exec proxy brief + compact demo window for Clocktower Financial
messages:
From: Amira Salih <amira@clocktower.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: clocktower_it_ops@clocktower.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick ask — compact exec window + proxy for Tuesday demo

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Our CIO (Rahul Desai) and VP of Engineering (Lina Moreno) are trying to attend the demo next Tuesday but there’s a calendar squeeze — Rahul can join for the first 25 minutes then has to hop to a board review. Lina is tentative.

Can we do a compact 35–40 minute exec-focused run where you highlight latency/cost controls and the canary/fallback behavior? Also, if either executive needs to drop early, can you confirm a proxy plan so we don’t lose thread momentum?

We can make 12:00–12:40 PM ET or 3:00–3:40 PM ET. Which works for Redwood? If neither, tell us a short alternate window and any pre-demo prep you need.

Thanks,
Amira
Head of Platform Partnerships, Clocktower Financial

Attachment: (none)
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Amira Salih <amira@clocktower.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — compact exec window + proxy for Tuesday demo

Amira — thanks for the context. 12:00–12:40 PM ET works best for our exec coverage. Quick notes: 1) we can trim to a focused 30–35 min run (15m product walkthrough, 10m live Q&A, 5–10m operational handoff). 2) We’ll assign a senior technical proxy if Lina needs to drop; Marcus will be the proxy by default. 3) We recommend a 15-minute dry-run the same morning to validate slides, access, and recording.

Proposed plan:
- 11:30 AM ET — 15-minute dry-run (recording enabled)
- 12:00 PM ET — 35-minute exec demo (we’ll prioritize CIO asks first)

I’ve looped in Marcus to confirm proxy availability and ensure we surface the runbook and deck. If you want Rahul’s top concerns surfaced up front, send a short list (1–3 bullets).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood demo checklist (referenced, deck + runbook will be attached shortly)

Naomi / Amira — I’m on standby as the technical proxy. Confirming I can cover the Q&A if Lina drops early. Two small asks from my side:

1) Can you keep the first 10 minutes strictly exec-facing (latency SLAs, failover policies, security posture)? I’ll take on the deeper architecture questions after the handoff.
2) Please share the shortened runbook and the deck exported as PDF; I’ll load a backup remote session just in case the attendee count or network changes.

Irene — can you confirm you can run the 11:30 dry-run with Amira’s team and validate SSO + recording permissions?

—Marcus
